title: 第3章 捶死御空境第4章 他又变强了
slug: 我修天道见谁都能一招秒
content_zh:
这哪跟哪的事儿啊？
自己都答应退婚了，对方却要废了自己？
这家伙都脑补出了什么啊？
神经病吧？
“明辛，你要做什么？”
罗峰怒喝道。
“闭嘴！”
明辛一挥手，一股寒气瞬间将罗峰笼罩。
“呃……”
罗峰顿时脸色发白，身子忍不住的颤抖起来。
“你……你是御空境？”
罗峰颤声道。
武道修行，一炼体、二聚气、三化灵，四御空，五通玄。
此为前五大境界。
罗峰如今是化灵境三重，便已经是边北城排名前三的强者了。
整个边北城，已经百年时间，没有出现过御空境修为的人物了。
但眼前的明辛，居然是御空境！
那也就意味着，他一个人，就有横压整个边北城的力量。
“蝼蚁！”
明辛看着罗峰，不屑的说了一声。

而后，他低头看着罗天，道：“罗天，别说我以大欺小。
我给你两个选择。
一，我放了你，但要杀你全族之人。
二，你现在跪在我面前，让我废了你丹田，斩断你四肢，挖出的双眼和舌头，但你全族性命可保。”
两个选择，其心何其歹毒？
“蓝秀儿，你我两家可是世交，就算婚约不成，也不至于如此吧？”
罗峰绝望的看着蓝秀儿说道。
希望她能说一句话，劝解一下自己的师父。
孰料蓝秀儿眼中闪过一丝阴毒之色，冷然道：“世交？什么世交？不过就是你罗峰的父亲，救过我爷爷一命罢了。
但我爷爷求你救了么？还不是你们罗家为了自己的名声才这么做的？”
“你救了我爷爷，但你罗家也得到了名声！
所以，我蓝家，根本不欠你什么！”
“你……”
罗峰气得都要吐血了。
自家几代人掏心掏肺对人家那么好，可对方居然是这样想的！
“怎么样，选好了么？”
明辛一脸阴笑的说道。
“少主，你快走，将来为我报仇！
我罗荣不是怕死的！”
罗荣怒吼道。

一位罗家长老也面色铁青道：“不错，我罗家人铁骨铮铮，可以站着死，绝不跪着活，更不受任何人胁迫！
罗天，走！”
“罗家人，死又何惧？”
罗家众人，全都视死如归。
“这……剧情不对啊！”
content_en:
Where does this happen?
You have agreed to break off the engagement, but the other party wants to abolish you?
What has this guy figured out?
Crazy?
"Mingxin, what are you going to do?"
Luo Feng shouted angrily.
"Shut up!"
Ming Xin waved his hand, and a chill instantly enveloped Luo Feng.
"Uh..."
Luo Feng's face suddenly turned pale, and his body couldn't help but tremble.
"You...are you in the air control realm?"
Luo Feng said tremblingly.
Martial arts practice consists of one body training, two Qi gathering, three spirit transformations, four air control, and five mysteries.
These are the first five realms.
Luo Feng is now at the third level of the Spiritual Transformation Realm, and is already among the top three strong men in Bianbeicheng.
In the entire Bianbei City, it has been a hundred years since there has been a person with the Sky Control Realm cultivation level.
But the Mingxin in front of him turned out to be in the Sky Control Realm!
That means that he alone has the power to suppress the entire Bianbei City.
"Ant!"
Ming Xin looked at Luo Feng and said disdainfully.
Then, he looked down at Luo Tian and said, "Luo Tian, don't say that I am bullying the small.
I'll give you two options.
One, I will let you go, but I will kill your entire clan.
Second, you kneel in front of me now and let me destroy your Dantian, cut off your limbs, and dig out your eyes and tongue, but the lives of your entire family can be saved. "
Two choices, how vicious is his heart?
"Lan Xiu'er, our families are family friends. Even if the engagement fails, it won't be like this, right?"
Luo Feng looked at Lan Xiuer desperately and said.
I hope she can say a word to persuade her master.
Unexpectedly, Lan Xiuer's eyes flashed with a sinister look, and she said coldly: "A family friend? What a family friend? It's just your Luo Feng's father who saved my grandfather's life.
But did my grandfather ask you to save him? Didn’t your Luo family do this just for your own reputation? "
"You saved my grandfather, but your Luo family also gained fame!
Therefore, I, the Lan family, owe you nothing at all! "
"You..."
Luo Feng was so angry that he almost vomited blood.
For generations, my family has been so kind to others with all their heart and soul, but this is what the other person actually thinks!
"How's it going? Have you made your choice?"
Ming Xin said with a sinister smile.
"Young Master, leave quickly and avenge me in the future!
I, Luo Rong, am not afraid of death! "
Luo Rong roared.
An elder from the Luo family also looked livid and said: "Yes, our Luo family is strong and strong. We can die standing up and never live on our knees, and we will not be coerced by anyone!"
Luo Tian, let’s go! "
"Luo family, why are you afraid of death?"
Everyone in the Luo family looked forward to death.
"This... the plot is wrong!"
